tracks.genre: Thai trip-hop (dusty breakbeat, Rhodes and cello, late-night downtempo)
tracks.subject: Nit, browsing a Chatuchak second-hand stall, pulls a denim jacket off the rack and finds in the pocket a folded note in the handwriting of the best friend she stopped speaking to three years ago
